record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in linear series
record.original_question: Let X be the blow-up of P^2 at points p1, ..., pr, and let D = dH - m1E1 - ... - mrEr. Assume that D is special, meaning that D is effective and h^1(X,D)>0. Must every positive multiple nD with n>1 also be special?

evidence.quote: Assume that the divisor D is special (i.e., D is effective with h1(X, D) > 0). Is it then true that nD is special for all n > 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p_1, \ldots, p_r$ be distinct points of the complex projective plane $\mathbb{P}^2$, and let $\pi: X \to \mathbb{P}^2$ be the blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at $p_1, \ldots, p_r$, with exceptional divisors $E_1, \ldots, E_r$ and $H = \pi^* \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(1)$. For integers $d, m_1, \ldots, m_r$ consider the divisor class
$$D = dH - m_1 E_1 - \cdots - m_r E_r$$
on $X$. Call $D$ special if $D$ is effective and $h^1(X, \mathcal{O}_X(D)) > 0$ (equivalently, the linear system of plane curves of degree $d$ with multiplicity at least $m_i$ at $p_i$ is nonempty and has dimension strictly greater than the expected dimension $\max\{-1, \binom{d+2}{2} - 1 - \sum_i \binom{m_i+1}{2}\}$).

Question: If $D$ is special, must the divisor $nD = (nd)H - (nm_1)E_1 - \cdots - (nm_r)E_r$ also be special for every integer $n > 1$?
artifact.category_tag: Linear systems on blow-ups of the plane
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in surveys on linear series on blow-ups of the projective plane, related to the Segre–Harbourne–Gimigliano–Hirschowitz circle of conjectures. Web searches did not turn up a definitive resolution (proof or counterexample) in the published literature, so the current status is treated as unknown/open.

status_evidence.title: General blow-ups of the projective plane (Szemberg–Tutaj-Gasińska)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies special linear systems on blow-ups of P^2 with general base points and the Harbourne–Hirschowitz conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The speciality of linear systems on blow-ups of P^2 is an active area of research with several outstanding conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Degenerations of planar linear systems (Ciliberto–Miranda)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses non-special linear systems and degeneration techniques for linear systems on P^2 with multiple base points.
status_evidence.claim: Speciality questions for linear systems on blow-ups of P^2 remain a central topic without complete resolution.
